problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute budget allocations across 19 community projects to maximize overall community benefit.  
The profile of each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.096, impact factor 0.092, allocation limits [0.045, 0.860]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.156, impact factor 0.254, allocation limits [0.085, 0.821]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.077, impact factor 0.127, allocation limits [0.097, 0.456]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.078, impact factor 0.270, allocation limits [0.012, 0.771]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.055, impact factor 0.276, allocation limits [0.037, 0.366]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.164, impact factor 0.021, allocation limits [0.062, 0.868]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.110, impact factor 0.197, allocation limits [0.003, 0.345]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.198, impact factor 0.030, allocation limits [0.005, 0.498]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.096, impact factor 0.038, allocation limits [0.001, 0.668]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.042, impact factor 0.243, allocation limits [0.011, 0.787]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.051, impact factor 0.220, allocation limits [0.032, 0.462]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.079, impact factor 0.090, allocation limits [0.069, 0.402]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.089, impact factor 0.229, allocation limits [0.044, 0.383]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.124, impact factor 0.126, allocation limits [0.017, 0.576]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.071, impact factor 0.171, allocation limits [0.019, 0.376]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.136, impact factor 0.101, allocation limits [0.090, 0.817]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.174, impact factor 0.188, allocation limits [0.037, 0.752]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.198, impact factor 0.124, allocation limits [0.090, 0.833]  
* Project S: benefit score 0.184, impact factor 0.212, allocation limits [0.099, 0.880]  

Each project must receive a proportion of the total budget within its specified limits, and the sum of all budget proportions must equal one.  
To ensure timely completion, the set of priority projects P = {A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, L, M, N, O, P, R, S} must together receive at least 0.775 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the total community impact index must not exceed 0.191, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.089.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total benefit while satisfying all constraints.
